name: Balnir Snapdragons
summary: At Balnir Farmstead, vibrant snapdragons grow where the Scourge's corruption presses toward Tirisfal Glades. The Forsaken study their sensitivity to magic to watch for that corruption's spread.

sections.title: A Bloom in Ruin
sections.body: Balnir Snapdragons still bloom in the garden of Balnir Farmstead in eastern Tirisfal Glades. The homestead lies in ruin after the fall of Lordaeron and the rise of the Scourge. The Plaguelands border Tirisfal to the east, and the garden sits where the Lich King's blight presses against the region. Its flowers give the Forsaken a place to watch for the spread of that corruption.

sections.title: Magical Barometers
sections.body: Balnir Snapdragons are unusually sensitive to atmospheric magic, making them living barometers for magical blights. Anastasia Hartwell and the Forsaken mages in the Undercity seek fresh flowers from the farmstead's window boxes. They send the plants to the Royal Apothecary Society for study, hoping to measure how far the Lich King's plague has seeped across the border into Tirisfal's soil.

faq.q: Where can Balnir Snapdragons be found?
faq.answer: Balnir Snapdragons grow in flower boxes and garden beds around the ruined Balnir Farmstead in eastern Tirisfal Glades, near the Western Plaguelands.

faq.q: Why does Anastasia Hartwell want these snapdragons?
faq.answer: Anastasia Hartwell wants fresh snapdragons sent to Undercity apothecaries. Their sensitivity to latent magical energies can help measure whether the Plaguelands' taint is spreading into Tirisfal Glades.
Balnir Snapdragons grow in the garden of Balnir Farmstead, the family homestead that gives them their name. The Scourge ruined the farm along with the rest of Lordaeron's countryside.

faq.q: Did the Scourge destroy the Balnir flowers?
faq.answer: No. Snapdragons still grow in the garden of Balnir Farmstead. Their growth so close to the Plaguelands lets Anastasia Hartwell's researchers study whether the plague has entered Tirisfal Glades.

angles.text: As a Forsaken mage, you can study Balnir Snapdragons as conduits for magic. Their sensitivity helps measure how magical blights distort ambient leylines.
As Forsaken, you can use the flowers to watch your eastern border. Their readings can warn Undercity researchers if the Lich King's corruption is overtaking Tirisfal's soil.
